images.caption: Figure 1:Three paradigms for video evaluation.Metric suites score predefined dimensions, while MLLM judges produce reasoning reports.FVScorecompiles explicit and video-conditioned implicit propositions, evaluates their confidence traces, and reports dimension scores with timestamped evidence.

Figure 2:FVScore, which compiles the user prompt and video observations into explicit and implicit propositions, verifies them via specialized neural and symbolic tools, and applies Perception-Aware Calibration to produce timestamp-grounded scores and reports.

Figure 3:Qualitative studiesbetween a holistic baseline andFVScore.Top:In the logistics scenario, the baseline hallucinates perfect physics, whileFVScorecatches localized artifacts (e.g., box morphing) via implicit propositions.Bottom:In the timer scenario,FVScoretracks monotonic countdowns and cross-modal triggers to accurately penalize logical failures where baselines fail.
Figure 5:Distribution of video scores onFVBenchbefore (blue) and after (red) applying PAC, compared to human ratings (green).
